f1.title: Isinqamuleli sokukopisha
f1.body: Kukhompyutha ye-Windows, thayipha isinqamuleli sekhibhodi esikopisha umbhalo okhethiwe.
f1.hint: Cabanga ngohlamvu lokuqala lwegama elithi "copy". Isimo: ctrl+?

f2.title: Londoloza idokhumenti yomsebenzi
f2.body: Ubhale isicelo sekhefu ku-Microsoft Word. Thayipha igama eliphelele lefayela ozolilondoloza ngalo: sebenzisa igama elithi leave-request, bese ufaka isandiso sedokhumenti ye-Word, kanye nechashazi.
f2.hint: Isandiso siza ngemva kwegama futhi siqala ngechashazi. Isimo: leave-request.????

f3.title: Thumela isicelo sekhefu nge-imeyili
f3.body: Bhala i-imeyili esemthethweni ucela umphathi wakho ikhefu kusuka mhla zi-7 kuya mhla zi-11 kuZibandlela 2026. Faka isihloko, ukubingelela, izinsuku, isizathu, ozokwenza umsebenzi wakho ungekho, nokuvalelisa ngenhlonipho. Bhala okungenani izinhlamvu eziyi-20.
f3.hint: Qala ngesihloko esicacile, bese ubhala imisho emifushane.

w1.title: Hlanganisa nge-SUM
w1.body: Thayipha ifomula ye-Excel esebenzisa i-SUM ukuhlanganisa amangqamuzana kusuka ku-A1 kuya ku-A5.

w2.title: Bika isilinganiso sokuthengisa
w2.body: Umphathi wakho ufuna ukwazi isilinganiso sokuthengisa. Amanani okuthengisa akumangqamuzana B2 kuya ku-B10. Thayipha ifomula ekhipha isilinganiso.
w2.hint: Sebenzisa umsebenzi we-Excel wesilinganiso, uwunike ingqamuzana lokuqala nelokugcina.

w3.title: Hlela isabelomali sesitolo
w3.body: Imali engenayo yesitolo (R20 000) iku-B2. Izindleko ziku-B3 kuya ku-B6: irenti R6 000, isitoko R7 000, ugesi R1 500, ezokuthutha R2 000. Bhala ifomula yazo zonke izindleko ku-B7 neyemali esele ku-B8. Chaza ukuthi ungaxwayisa kanjani uma izindleko zidlula imali engenayo, bese uphakamisa ishadi elilodwa. Bhala okungenani izinhlamvu eziyi-20.

d1.title: Phrinta isibingelelo
d1.body: Thayipha ikhodi ye-Python ephrinta igama elithi Hello. Sebenzisa usonhlamvukazi H.
d1.hint: Sebenzisa umsebenzi we-print nombhalo ophakathi kwezicaphuno.

d2.title: Phinda isikhumbuzo
d2.body: Isikripthi kumele sithumele izikhumbuzo ezi-5. Bhala umugqa wokuqala we-loop ye-for ephindaphinda izikhathi ezi-5, usebenzisa i-variable i kanye ne-range.
d2.hint: Isimo: for i in range(...): Ungakhohlwa ikholoni ekugcineni.

d3.title: Bala abaphumelele
d3.body: Isikhungo sokuqeqesha sinala mamaki: marks = [72, 45, 88, 39]. Bhala ikhodi ye-Python ebala ukuthi mangaki amamaki angu-50 noma ngaphezulu, bese iphrinta lelo nani. Sebenzisa i-loop nesitatimende se-if. Bhala okungenani izinhlamvu eziyi-20.
d3.hint: Qala isibali ku-0, bese ungeza u-1 kulowo nalowo ophumelele.

fin1.title: Isabelomali sanyanga zonke sasekhaya (Rand)
fin1.body: Umholo wanyanga zonke wasekhaya (R14 500) uku-B2. Izindleko zanyanga zonke ziku-B3:B7: irenti R4 500, ukudla R3 200, ugesi R1 400, ezokuthutha R1 800, idatha R600. Faka u-=SUM(B3:B7) ku-B8 wezindleko eziphelele no-=B2-B8 ku-B9 wemali esele.
fin1.hint: Sebenzisa u-=SUM(B3:B7) ku-B8, bese ususa u-B8 emholweni oku-B2.

fin2.title: Inzalo yemalimboleko encane kanye nokukhokha konke
fin2.body: Imalimboleko yomuntu siqu engu-R10 000 iku-B2, izinga lenzalo lonyaka (0.18 elingu-18%) liku-B3, kanti isikhathi seminyaka (2) siku-B4. Faka ifomula ku-B5 ukubala inzalo elula (=B2*B3*B4) nakwi-B6 ukubala inani eliphelele lokukhokha (=B2+B5).
fin2.hint: Phindaphinda u-B2 ngo-B3 nango-B4 ku-B5, bese uhlanganisa u-B2 no-B5 ku-B6.

fin3.title: Ukuzilolongela i-SARS eFiling Ungaxhumekile: Ukubhalisa
fin3.body: Zilolonge ukubhalisela i-SARS eFiling ngokuphepha ungaxhumekile ku-inthanethi ngaphandle kokuthinta ingosi kahulumeni. Faka inombolo yentela yokuzilolonga enamadijithi ayi-10 (isb. 0123456789), inombolo ye-SA ID yokuzilolonga enamadijithi ayi-13 (isb. 9901015009087), khetha u-Individual, bese uqinisekisa umthetho wokuphepha othi never-share.
fin3.hint: Sebenzisa izinombolo zokuzilolonga kuphela. Inombolo yentela ye-SARS inamadijithi ayi-10 aqala ngo-0, 1, 2, 3, noma 9.

fin4.title: Ukuzilolongela i-SARS eFiling Ungaxhumekile: I-IRP5 ne-ITR12
fin4.body: Ukulingisa okungaxhumekile ku-inthanethi: funda isitifiketi sesampula se-IRP5 sango-2026 bese ufaka amakhodi e-SARS afanele efomini lakho le-ITR12. Ikhodi 3601 (Umholo Ophelele): R180 000; Ikhodi 4102 (Intela ye-PAYE): R14 500; Ikhodi 4005 (Imali Yezokwelapha): R18 000. Qinisekisa isifungo ukuze uthumele ungaxhumekile.
